lastCompletedStory.title: Decide headless-vs-tmux once in host.ts and branch exactly once in loop.ts

nextStoryContext: US-005 wired the actual headless-vs-tmux DECISION: `host.ts`'s `buildSupervisorOptions` now builds a `headlessDispatchFn` closure (right next to the existing `headless` const, GOTCHA C) that composes `buildHeadlessChildInvocation` (US-001) + `openHeadlessDispatchLog` (US-002) + `runHeadlessDispatch` (US-003) into ONE call: `(params: {uuid, storyId, taskPrompt, model}) => Promise<HeadlessDispatchOutcome>`. It is always built (cheap closure) and always threaded into the `opts` bag as `headlessDispatchFn`, but only ever INVOKED by loop.ts when `opts.headless === true`. `loop.ts` (`RunSupervisorOptions.headlessDispatchFn`, new field next to `headless`) wraps the ENTIRE tmux dispatch+poll+retry sequence (previously lines 1237-1647: shellCmd build, ensureWorkerPane, container ensure/preflight, dockerExecWrap, codexAuthPreflight, runVerifiedWorkerDispatch, the isPaneAlive poll loop, the pane-died/timeout dead-worker retry/backoff, and the final `capturePane`) in a single `if (opts.headless === true) { <headless branch> } else { <existing tmux code, byte-for-byte unchanged, reindented one level> }`. The headless branch: clears any stale worker-report, emits `worker-start`/`worker-end` with `mode: 'headless'`, calls `headlessDispatchFn` exactly once, and maps its two possible outcomes onto the pre-existing CAM-44 vocabulary WITHOUT touching tmux: `'completed'` resets `deadWorkerStreak` and falls through into the SAME shared `readWorkerOutcome` call both branches converge on (paneText stays `''`, since worker-report.json/prd.json/handoff.json are the real completion evidence, not pane text); `'idle-timeout'` increments `deadWorkerStreak` and reuses the exact `computeBackoffMs`/`MAX_DEAD_WORKER_RETRIES` cap the tmux timeout path uses, but skips `runCheckedWorkerSentinel` (no pane to echo/kill into -- `runHeadlessDispatch` already SIGTERM'd the real child itself, GOTCHA E). Net result: `isPaneAlive` is structurally unreachable when headless (never invoked, not just never triggered) and `respawn-pane` is never called. A caller that sets `headless: true` without supplying `headlessDispatchFn` gets a thrown `Error` at the dispatch site (loud failure, no silent tmux fallback). Ceiling raises this story made (single `_ref` note): src/supervisor/host.ts 1163->1191, src/supervisor/loop.ts 2788->2902. New test file `test/supervisor/headless-route.test.ts` pins all 3 ACs plus the full 6151-pass suite stayed green. Gap intentionally left open for a future story (not required by this PRD's notes, flag if it becomes relevant): headless mode is CLAUDE-only by construction (`headless-argv.ts` hardcodes `argv[0] = 'claude'`, never routed through `selectAdapter`/`BackendAdapter`), so a `headless: true` + `implBackend: 'codex'` combination is currently unvalidated/unspecified -- the model resolution above it (`resolvePhaseModel`) still runs unconditionally for both branches and would happily resolve a codex model slug that the headless child invocation then silently ignores. Similarly, `workerIsolation: 'container'` + `headless: true` is unvalidated: the headless branch never calls `ensureContainerFn`/`preflightContainerFn`/`dockerExecWrap`, so today headless always dispatches on the bare host regardless of the configured isolation mode.

officialDocsValidated.summary: Pure internal DI-seam wiring and control-flow restructuring (one if/else branch point in loop.ts, one closure in host.ts) that composes already-validated US-001/US-002/US-003 primitives (buildHeadlessChildInvocation, openHeadlessDispatchLog, runHeadlessDispatch). No new external library surface (Bun.spawn, the claude CLI's --print/stream-json contract, etc.) was introduced or re-touched at the API-shape level.
